title: Queen Mary Postcard Long Beach CA Mike Roberts B2175 Stern Sunset Unposted
condition_description: Unposted and unwritten. Deckle edges. Light toning on the back. See photos.
description:
Official Queen Mary Souvenir postcard, City of Long Beach, California. Published by Mike Roberts, Berkeley ("the Continental card"), card no. B2175, circa 1970s.

Front: the Queen Mary's stern with sunset reflecting off the portside, tour boarding ramps at left, and the propeller housing at the water line. "Queen Mary - Liverpool" on the stern.

Unposted and blank on the back. Deckle (scalloped) edges, light toning on the back. See photos.

Ships flat with a stiffener in a protective mailer.
